benchmark.p_status: official released model trained specifically for three-shot image manipulation
benchmark.released_arm: InstaManip-17B-3shot; staged and hash-pinned by this bundle
benchmark.demo_policy: same-source, query excluded, released order, no fallback

task_instructions.colorization: Colorize the grayscale image with realistic colors while preserving its exact content, structure, and lighting.
task_instructions.deblurring: Remove the blur and restore a sharp image without changing the scene, objects, colors, or composition.
task_instructions.denoising: Remove the image noise while preserving all real details, colors, edges, and scene content.
task_instructions.edge_detection: Convert the image into an edge map containing only white object and region boundaries on a black background.
task_instructions.face_landmarks: Locate the facial landmarks and output only the colored landmark points on a black background, following the exact point and color convention shown in the examples.
task_instructions.human_pose_2d: Locate the person’s 2D body joints and output only the colored joint markers on a black background, following the exact joint and color convention shown in the examples.
task_instructions.inpainting: Fill in the black missing regions with content consistent with the surrounding image, while leaving every unmasked pixel unchanged.
task_instructions.instance_segmentation: Segment every individual object instance and output only a flat color mask, using one solid color per instance and the exact color convention shown in the examples.
task_instructions.relative_depth: Predict a dense relative-depth map for the entire image, following the exact grayscale depth direction and intensity convention shown in the examples.
task_instructions.saliency_detection: Identify the most visually salient foreground object and output a binary mask with the salient region in white and the background in black.
task_instructions.semantic_segmentation: Assign every pixel its semantic class and output only a flat color segmentation mask, using the exact class-color convention shown in the examples with no photographic texture or shading.
task_instructions.super_resolution: Restore a high-resolution version of the image with faithful fine detail while preserving the exact objects, geometry, identity, colors, and composition.
task_instructions.surface_normals: Predict a dense per-pixel surface-normal map encoded as RGB colors, following the exact coordinate and color convention shown in the examples without retaining photographic texture.

inference.instruction_status: exact user-supplied deterministic task instruction selected by Bench-v2 task label
inference.exemplar_preprocessing: RGB 256 -> Pillow resize((1024,1024)) with resample omitted exactly as official evaluator -> official 448 CLIP transform
inference.query_visual_preprocessing: RGB 256 -> official 448 CLIP transform without the exemplar-only 1024 intermediate
inference.latent_dtype: deterministic CPU float32 noise is hashed then cast to bfloat16; the upstream forced-float32 image tensor is recast to bfloat16 at the VAE encode boundary

runtime.authorized_tpu_policy: READY/HEALTHY/Spot west4 v5litepod-32 whose exact resource name contains kristine, or an exact current named-resource Python authorization
runtime.agent_partitioning: PyTorch/XLA SPMD-FSDP over a eight-worker, 16-device global mesh and each Llama decoder layer
runtime.source_patch: diagnostic-only isnan/isinf checks skipped on XLA; the hash-pinned custom pipeline routes timestep and sigma scalars through an output-equivalent Diffusers 0.25 Euler adapter as XLA device data; legacy callback order is preserved
runtime.xla_generation_cache_contract: official prefill and greedy decoding with fixed-capacity per-layer KV tensors; the processor-forced 64 image tokens plus end token are evaluated in one causally masked teacher-forced block and only the official 64-token hidden span is retained
runtime.diffusion_batch_contract: one same-task query per global TPU device with replicated SDXL weights and an explicitly sharded batch axis; final partial task batches are padded by duplicating their last query and only real rows are retained
runtime.backend_label: PyTorch/XLA v5litepod-32 eight-worker SPMD-FSDP port; official CUDA numerical parity is not established
runtime.qualification: reuses the hash-pinned q43 v5litepod-32 port/runtime qualification; that receipt is explicitly bound to the neutral-prompt reference plan, while this arm has a distinct plan identity and task-instruction hash
runtime.known_history: v5p-8 and default-vmem v5e-8 failed before the first PNG; the 32MiB v5e-8 retry has no locally preserved completion/PNG evidence; v5p-16 run 20261014T005924Z-2912903 exposed unbounded dynamic-KV recompilation; q3-gas failed before its first PNG on a float32-to-BF16 VAE boundary; b97678 q2 completed smoke A after roughly 94 minutes of compilation and warm smoke B diffusion in roughly 2.5 minutes, but worker 2 lost the PJRT slice during teardown after faster workers exited. The q3 repair added causal forced-block fusion, 16-way device-sharded diffusion, Python cross-host rendezvous, the VAE dtype adapter, and strict output/determinism/runtime gates. The q4 v6e-16 attempt was Spot-reclaimed during setup. The q5 23430e attempt completed setup but aborted before smoke A when foreign Python/VFIO occupancy appeared. This q6 port preserves the repaired failure traps and inference fixes, adds an all-Python occupancy refusal, and uses a fresh exact-target v5litepod-32 receipt family
